worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.summar: Tell a joke that gives nearby foes one interruptible short interruption, and leaves a lingering snowfield where you stood while you slip to a standable spot away from the threat; with a reserve it swaps to it at that same spot.
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.use.2: Leave snow behind while bowing out
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.descri: The hush covers a radius of %1$s blocks: foes inside take one short interruption at once (their current action is interrupted; actions that cannot be interrupted or are immune carry on), and carry the cold mark about %2$s. The exit does not depend on that interruption landing.
The joke leaves a radius-%1$s snowfield where it was told, lasting %2$s; the area counts as snowing and anything inside is marked as standing in snowfall.
Retreats to a standable spot away from the nearest enemy (up to %1$s blocks); a reserve takes over at that same spot, while without one the caster only steps away. With no enemy nearby it stays put.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.timing: Centred on yourself (range %1$s blocks); after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to tell the joke, recovers %3$s, and cools down %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.growth: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.chillyreception.prefer: On = heavy punchline: wider hush (x1.25), longer chill (x1.3) and denser snow (x1.3), but shorter snow (x0.8) and cooldown +18 ticks. Off = understated: smaller and shorter hush, but the snow lasts longer (x1.2) and cools down 12 ticks sooner.
The companion only tells the joke while a threat is within this distance; lower tells it up close, higher clears the room in advance.
Below this health ratio the companion prioritizes the joke to get out; higher leaves earlier, lower stays and fights longer.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to tell the joke.
